# Security Policy

Thank you for helping keep this project secure.

## Supported versions

The default branch is the currently supported development version.

Older versions may receive fixes at the maintainer's discretion.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report security issues privately using GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature if available.

When reporting, please include:

- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce it
- Any affected files, commands, or configuration
- Potential impact, if known

## Disclosure

Please allow time for the issue to be investigated and fixed before public disclosure.
